title: Hoshino Ichika — Meeting Miku〔Part1〕Side Story (Part 1)

rows.Speaker: Little Ichika
rows.Line: We should play a Miku song together!

rows.Speaker: Little Shiho
rows.Line: Oh, this is a pretty cool song...

rows.Speaker: Little Ichika
rows.Line: See what I mean?

rows.Speaker: Little Saki
rows.Line: Miku's also really cool!

rows.Speaker: Little Ichika
rows.Line: I know, right?!

rows.Speaker: Little Ichika
rows.Line: Let's get our band started!
bgm_area00001
School SEKAI

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: That's how we ended up forming our band.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Wow. Miku told us that happened, but I'm still amazed by how you all decided to form a band in elementary school.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Oh, Ichi, can you tell us more about what happened after you got your band started?!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Sure.
Then, I'll continue...

rows.Speaker: Little Saki
rows.Line: He said he'd lend you his guitar?! That's great, Ichi!

rows.Speaker: Little Ichika
rows.Line: Yeah, he said I could use it after I told him we want to play that Miku song together!

rows.Speaker: Little Ichika
rows.Line: Oh, he also helped me tune it since he apparently hadn't played it in a while.

rows.Speaker: Little Honami
rows.Line:
Really?!
Your dad is such a nice person.

rows.Speaker: Little Ichika
rows.Line: Hehe. He even told me about the strings and how to play a few chords.

rows.Speaker: Little Ichika
rows.Line:
He seemed really happy for some reason.
Why do you think that is?

rows.Speaker: Little Ichika
rows.Line: I mean, I honestly wasn't sure if he'd actually lend me his guitar...

rows.Speaker: Little Shiho
rows.Line:
This is just my guess...
But I think he's happy about you showing interest.

rows.Speaker: Little Shiho
rows.Line: Because that means you like the same thing he does. I mean, I'd be happy.

rows.Speaker: Little Ichika
rows.Line: Huh...?

rows.Speaker: Little Honami
rows.Line: Yeah! Now that you mention it, Ichika, you told us all about those Miku songs.

rows.Speaker: Little Honami
rows.Line: Whenever Shiho or Saki said one of them was cool, it put such a big smile on your face!

rows.Speaker: Little Ichika
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Little Ichika
rows.Line: You're right! I was really happy when they said that!

rows.Speaker: Little Ichika
rows.Line: (So, Dad felt the same way...?!)

rows.Speaker: Little Shiho
rows.Line: Oh yeah, Honami, have you found a drum kit you can use...?

rows.Speaker: Little Honami
rows.Line: Yes! I asked the music teacher and there's apparently a set in the prep room that no one has used in a while.

rows.Speaker: Little Ichika
rows.Line: Oh, so there is one at school.

rows.Speaker: Little Shiho
rows.Line:
What did I say?
I told you there was a drum kit hiding under that dust cover.

rows.Speaker: Little Ichika
rows.Line: Yeah, it was definitely worth peeking through the little window in the door.

rows.Speaker: Little Saki
rows.Line: Anyway, what happened after that?!

rows.Speaker: Little Honami
rows.Line: After I learned about that drum kit, the teacher agreed to teach me when we're both free!

rows.Speaker: Little Saki
rows.Line: What?! That teacher can play the drums?!

rows.Speaker: Little Shiho
rows.Line: That's great. Even if you were able to borrow a drum kit, I was worried that no one would be able to teach you how to play them.

rows.Speaker: Little Ichika
rows.Line: Then, that means we all have our instruments!

rows.Speaker: Little Ichika
rows.Line: (We really get to be in a band together...!)

rows.Speaker: Little Shiho
rows.Line:
So, what are we gonna play?
Do you already have a song for us, Ichika?

rows.Speaker: Little Ichika
rows.Line: Umm... It's a little hard to play, but I was thinking that we could try the first song I showed all of you.

rows.Speaker: Little Shiho
rows.Line: Sure. I actually kinda want to learn it as well.

rows.Speaker: Little Saki
rows.Line: Wow... How cool would it be if we all managed to learn how to play that song♪

rows.Speaker: Little Honami
rows.Line:
*Nod*
I still don't know if I'll do well on the drums, but I promise to do my best.

rows.Speaker: Little Ichika
rows.Line: All of you...

rows.Speaker: Little Ichika
rows.Line: Yeah! Let's do our best!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: And the song you all first played after coming over to SEKAI was that one, yes?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Yeah. But we were pretty bad since we hadn't played together for so long.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Still, that was super fun!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: It was...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: That story also sounds interesting, but I'd like to hear more about what you were all like when you were little.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
Me too...
You only just got to the part where you each had your instrument.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Yes, I'd love to hear how things went from there.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Sure. Then, I guess we should talk about how we practiced back then.
